product_boundary: Code observations plus declared context plus explicit unknowns or contradictions plus provenance plus accountable human review produce reviewable evidence, not an autonomous legal determination.

surfaces.user_purpose: Run local observation, context, evidence, integrity, and review workflows.
surfaces.input: Command arguments, local files, explicit configuration, and declared facts.
surfaces.output_representation: Text or the stable JSON envelope; selected commands also emit files.

authority.filesystem: Selected local project and explicit output paths

surfaces.remaining_limitations: Legacy command names classify, comply, compliance, exempt, and conform need compatibility-safe migration.

surfaces.user_purpose: Read detector observations, context gaps, provenance, and review steps in a terminal.
surfaces.input: Shared observation and review-evidence records.
surfaces.output_representation: Human-readable terminal text.

authority.filesystem: Read-only scan input plus explicit outputs

surfaces.remaining_limitations: Some advanced commands retain older terminology in compatibility output.

surfaces.user_purpose: Consume versioned review evidence in automation.
surfaces.input: Shared observation and review-evidence records.
surfaces.output_representation: Stable JSON envelope with public review schema 2.0 data.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Consumers of removed legacy public fields require migration.

surfaces.user_purpose: Review scan evidence in a portable document.
surfaces.input: Public review schema and renderer metadata.
surfaces.output_representation: Accessible HTML evidence-preparation report.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Accessibility automation does not establish conformance.

surfaces.user_purpose: Create a portable rendering of review evidence.
surfaces.input: Public review schema and optional PDF dependency.
surfaces.output_representation: PDF evidence-preparation report.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Requires an optional dependency; print and assistive-technology review remains incomplete.

surfaces.user_purpose: Attach code-observable findings to code-review tooling.
surfaces.input: Detector findings and source locations.
surfaces.output_representation: SARIF with observation and limitation properties.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Host platforms may visually overstate SARIF severity.

surfaces.user_purpose: Exercise local adapters for check, indicator labelling, evidence gaps, and questionnaires.
surfaces.input: Bounded JSON requests to health, check, classify, gap, questionnaire, and dashboard routes.
surfaces.output_representation: JSON envelope or bounded error response.

authority.network: Loopback by default; explicit unsafe acknowledgement for non-loopback

surfaces.remaining_limitations: No authentication; not a production API.

surfaces.user_purpose: Allow a local MCP client to request check, indicator labelling, or evidence-gap output.
surfaces.input: regula_check, regula_classify, or regula_gap within an explicit workspace root.
surfaces.output_representation: MCP text content containing bounded JSON.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Native Windows containment has not been executed.

surfaces.user_purpose: Record declared context, unknowns, contradictions, and reviewer questions without uploading source.
surfaces.input: User answers and optional in-browser single-file scan.
surfaces.output_representation: Versioned assessment evidence and recoverable share payload schema 4.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Legacy links are explicitly lossy; fluent legal-language review remains external.

surfaces.user_purpose: Bundle observations, provenance, limitations, and reviewer-completable decisions.
surfaces.input: Project scan plus declared context.
surfaces.output_representation: Versioned evidence bundle and integrity manifest.

authority.filesystem: Project input and explicit bundle output

surfaces.remaining_limitations: Integrity verification does not validate legal meaning or evidence completeness.

surfaces.user_purpose: Prepare Article 43 and Annex IV material for accountable review.
surfaces.input: Code observations, declared facts, and empty reviewer fields.
surfaces.output_representation: Reviewer-completable scaffold, never a certificate.

authority.filesystem: Project input and explicit output directory

surfaces.remaining_limitations: Qualified conformity and legal review remains external.

surfaces.user_purpose: Prepare governance and model-card evidence fields.
surfaces.input: Code observations and user declarations.
surfaces.output_representation: Markdown scaffolds with unknown and human-decision fields.

authority.filesystem: Project input and explicit output directory

surfaces.remaining_limitations: Generated content does not verify organisational practice or model behaviour.

surfaces.user_purpose: Learn the bounded workflow from tracked illustrative inputs.
surfaces.input: Repository fixtures.
surfaces.output_representation: Reproducible example observations and declared-context flow.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Synthetic examples are not representative validity evidence.

surfaces.user_purpose: Understand product purpose, limitations, provenance, and navigation before evaluation.
surfaces.input: Generated public facts and locale content.
surfaces.output_representation: HTML metadata, Open Graph data, JSON-LD, llms.txt, and visible copy.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Deployment state is externally controlled; translated legal wording needs fluent review.

surfaces.user_purpose: Understand a configured scan that matched no indicator.
surfaces.input: Zero detector matches under the recorded configuration.
surfaces.output_representation: No indicator found, configuration provenance, limitations, and unresolved context.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Absence of a match is not absence of legal relevance or risk.

surfaces.user_purpose: Preserve unanswered or explicitly unknown context.
surfaces.input: Partial assessment or missing declared facts.
surfaces.output_representation: insufficient_information with missing facts and reviewer questions.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: A reviewer must resolve facts outside code.

surfaces.user_purpose: Expose incompatible declarations rather than manufacture a result.
surfaces.input: Contradictory declared context.
surfaces.output_representation: Contradiction list, provenance, and human-review requirement.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Conflict resolution is an accountable human task.

surfaces.user_purpose: Recover from invalid input, malformed links, corrupt cache, or blocked authority.
surfaces.input: Malformed, unsupported, corrupt, oversized, or out-of-scope input.
surfaces.output_representation: Visible bounded error with no manufactured assessment.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Some browser error announcements still require manual assistive-technology review.

surfaces.user_purpose: Summarise untrusted issue text for human review without repository publication authority.
surfaces.input: Bounded issue metadata treated as untrusted data.
surfaces.output_representation: Strict review-only summary in the workflow job summary.

authority.network: Read issues and call the explicitly configured model endpoint

surfaces.remaining_limitations: Model privacy and output quality depend on the separately approved endpoint.

surfaces.user_purpose: Prepare blinded independent detector-rating packets.
surfaces.input: Versioned corpus items and zero or more independent ratings.
surfaces.output_representation: Rating packet schema 1.0 with explicit incomplete state.
surfaces.remaining_limitations: Two real ratings and adjudication remain external dependencies.
